TreeFinder — Third-Party Notices / 서드파티 오픈 소스 고지
==============================================================================

TreeFinder includes the open-source components listed below. Each component is
provided under its own license, which is reproduced in full in this file.
These licenses apply to those components only; TreeFinder itself is licensed
separately (see LICENSE).

TreeFinder에는 아래 오픈 소스 구성 요소가 포함되어 있습니다. 각 구성 요소는
자체 라이선스를 따르며 그 원문을 이 파일에 전재합니다. 이 라이선스들은 해당
구성 요소에만 적용되고, TreeFinder 자체의 사용권은 별도(LICENSE)입니다.

Contents / 목차
  1. SwiftTerm 1.15.0 — MIT
  2. rhwp 0.7.18 (bundled command-line HWP renderer) — MIT, plus statically linked Rust crates
  3. TOAST UI Editor 3.2.2 — MIT
     3a. ProseMirror — MIT (contained in the TOAST UI Editor bundle)
     3b. DOMPurify 2.3.3 — Apache License 2.0 (contained in the TOAST UI Editor bundle)
  4. Contributions received under the MIT License (v0.4.6 and earlier) / MIT 기여분
  Appendix A. Apache License, Version 2.0 (full text)

into it (name, version, and the license declared by each crate on crates.io).
All of them are permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, Zlib, ISC, Unicode,
CC0, Unlicense, 0BSD, BSL-1.0 or a choice among these); their copyright and
permission notices are retained in the respective crate sources.
